title: Normalized isomorphism between ordinary pro-etale tensor models
statement: For a scheme W and a commutative ring sheaf R on its small pro-etale site, let a,b be signed flat-term K-flat presentations of ordinary derived tensor [def-sfb-proetale-tensor-model]. There exists a natural isomorphism e:a.tensor ≅ b.tensor such that for every pair of flat-term K-flat complexes P,Q, the representative map of a followed by e on (QP,QQ) equals the representative map of b.

proof.text: Restriction along the product of the flat-term K-flat localizations is fully faithful. Pull back the isomorphism a.representative inverse followed by b.representative through that fully faithful functor.
Evaluate the map-preimage identity at P,Q and cancel the inverse representative isomorphism. This gives the displayed normalization.

lean.statement:
theorem tensorModelIso (W : Scheme.{u})
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology W) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (a b : ProEtaleTensorModel W R) :
    ∃ e : a.tensor ≅ b.tensor,
      ∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (proEtaleRingModules W R) ℤ)
        (hP : proEtaleFlatRepresentatives W R P)
        (hQ : proEtaleFlatRepresentatives W R Q),
        a.representative.hom.app (⟨P, hP⟩, ⟨Q, hQ⟩) ≫
          e.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P, DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q) =
        b.representative.hom.app (⟨P, hP⟩, ⟨Q, hQ⟩)
